classifications.rationale: The President presently designates and reserves the monument and withdraws federal lands, creating immediate legal effects, while also assigning internal management responsibility to the Secretaries. These Code 3 and Code 1 postures are inseparably combined in the supplied segment.
classifications.evidence: All Federal lands and interests in lands within the boundaries of the monument are hereby appropriated and withdrawn from all forms of entry, location, selection, sale, leasing, or other disposition under the public land laws

classifications.rationale: The Secretaries must later prepare and maintain a management plan and may promulgate appropriate implementing regulations, but the segment does not dictate a particular legally consequential regulatory outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Secretaries shall prepare a joint management plan

classifications.rationale: The Secretaries must consult and coordinate with expert agencies while developing and implementing management measures and pursue collaborative resource protection; these are internal administrative directions.
classifications.evidence: the Secretaries shall consult, designate, and involve as cooperating agencies the agencies with jurisdiction or special expertise

classifications.rationale: The segment both directs the Secretaries to impose specified prohibitions later, a Code 2 posture, and itself establishes that specified commercial fishing becomes prohibited after seven years, a Code 3 legal effect. It also grants discretionary permitting authority, so materially different postures are inseparably combined.
classifications.evidence: After 7 years, red crab and American lobster commercial fishing is prohibited in the monument.

classifications.rationale: The Armed Forces and cognizant components must adopt practicable internal measures and coordinate responsive and restorative action after relevant incidents; the segment manages executive operations without itself changing private legal rights.
classifications.evidence: the cognizant component shall promptly coordinate with the Secretaries
